death_pages_1:
You jolt awake in your quarters, drenched in cold sweat. The alarm is blaring.

You... died? At least it seemed like it. The exhaustion, the hunger, the darkness closing in — it was so real. But here you are, back in your bunk.

Was that just a dream? It had to be... right?
death_pages_2:
The alarm. Again. The same sequence of events.

You remember dying. You remember waking up here before. This can't be a coincidence.

Something is very wrong.
death_pages_3:
It's happening again. And again.

You're trapped in a time loop. Every death brings you back to this exact moment — the alarm, the crash, the struggle for survival.

You need to find a way to break the cycle.
death_pages_loop:
Cycle {loop}. You've lived through this {loop} times now.

The patterns are becoming clearer. The mistakes, the choices — you remember them all.

There has to be an exit. A way out of the loop. You just need to find it.
death_pages_manual_reset: But not this time either... your own choice changed nothing. You close your eyes hoping it's over — and then open them in the same quarters. Again. Right back to the beginning.

loc_gamma_crew_quarters_desc: The dimly lit crew quarters of Gamma Site. Personal effects are scattered across bunks, suggesting a hasty evacuation. A terminal on the far wall flickers with residual power.
loc_scout_ship_bridge_desc: The bridge of the scout ship, dark and silent. Consoles line the curved walls, most of them dark. The main viewport is cracked but intact, revealing the pale amber sky outside. A NAVIGATION console pulses weakly, while the CONTROLS panel sits within arm's reach at center. At the rear, an access hatch leads to ENGINEERING — the heart of the ship's systems.
loc_scout_ship_crew_quarters_desc: You wake in the cramped crew quarters of your scout ship. Emergency lighting casts long shadows across the small compartment. The hum of failing systems fills the air. Against the wall stands your BUNK — the last safe corner in this wreck. Ahead, a TERMINAL flickers with urgent warnings, its screen casting an otherworldly glow. Against the far wall, a sealed STORAGE LOCKER holds emergency supplies.
loc_scout_ship_main_area_desc: The ship's main gathering area. Tables and chairs are overturned from the crash. Emergency lights pulse dimly along the ceiling. A CAFETERIA counter sits against one wall, and a COMMUNICATIONS station occupies the corner.
loc_scout_ship_workshop_desc: A stark workshop, cold as a doghouse — but beneath the dust and spilled oil you can feel this place once ran at full tilt. The WORKBENCH directly ahead is cluttered but still functional. To the left, a PROTOTYPE BENCH holds a half-disassembled gadget tangled in cables. On the right, the FABRICATOR stands ready, its status lights pulsing faintly in standby. Further back, the GARAGE opens up — two folding scout bikes rest on the floor and a dust-covered rover sits on a lift ramp. In the corner, a TERMINAL blinks quietly, as if waiting to be noticed.
loc_workshop_desc: A cramped maintenance room cluttered with tools and partially assembled equipment. The air reeks of ozone and machine oil. Workbenches line the walls, covered in scattered blueprints.
log_end_loop_hint: Yeah... you've thought about it too, haven't you? Why not just end it on your own terms? Maybe you'll get out of this mess. Maybe you won't wake up at all. Press again if you're ready to risk it.
log_food_low_has: You're running low on food. Luckily you have some packaged food with you.
log_food_low_has_auto_hint: You're running low on food. You have packaged food in your inventory — enable auto-consume in the inventory settings.
log_food_low_none: You're running low on food! Your stomach is growling — find some before you collapse.
log_fuel_depleted: The reactor runs dry. Lights flicker and die. Life support switches to reserve power — oxygen levels begin dropping.
log_fuel_depletion_same_time: The reactor died at exactly the same time as before. Down to the minute. This can't be coincidence.
log_lifesupport_restored: The reactor hums back to life. Lights flicker and stabilize. Life support is back online — oxygen systems restarting.
log_lifesupport_uniform_hint_first: Your flight uniform hangs by the bunk in crew quarters. It has an integrated oxygen supply — might come in handy now.
log_lifesupport_uniform_hint_tried: That suit isn't sounding like such a bad idea now, is it? Your flight uniform is hanging by the bunk in crew quarters — with its own oxygen supply.
log_loop_triggered: Critical resources depleted: {resources}. Starting new loop...
log_need_ship_manual: You have no idea how to connect that cell. You need technical schematics — try the workshop terminal.
log_need_skill: This is way over your head. Maybe a repair manual would help...
log_need_skills_rover: This job requires both mechanical knowledge and engineering know-how. Without the vehicle manual and basic engineering training, you'd better not attempt this.
log_need_terminal_login: You need terminal access to make the necessary system changes. Without it, you can't reconfigure the reactor.
log_need_vehicle_manual_bikes: Light recon machines — but without the manual you can't run diagnostics. Try the workshop terminal.
log_need_vehicle_manual_rover: Without the manual you have no idea what to do with this mechanical beast. Maybe check the workshop terminal.
log_o2_depleted: Oxygen reserves depleted. No breathable air remains.
log_oxygen_same_time_warning: Oxygen reserves are draining… just like last time. You have {minutes} minutes of air remaining — same as the previous loop.
log_personal_o2_depleted: Your personal oxygen has run out! The uniform can no longer protect you.
log_reactor_terminal_hint: As you work, you realize — if you know the reactor's parameters, you should be able to optimize it remotely. Even from this terminal.
log_recycler_need_tools: You know what to do now, but you'll need proper tools. Time to find a basic repair kit.
log_recycler_no_idea: You examine the recycler from every angle. It's a complex machine and you have no idea where to start. Maybe a manual would help...
log_recycler_remember: You remember exactly how this works. Last time it took forever, but now you know what you're doing.
log_stamina_low: You feel exhausted. Maybe you should take a moment to rest at your bunk.
log_uniform_no_reason: The uniform hangs on the wall by your bunk — clean, ready. But why would you wear it? The ship has stable atmosphere. It'd just make you hot and restrict your movement. You leave it be.
log_water_full: You are not thirsty right now.
log_water_low_has: You're running low on water. Luckily you have some bottled water with you.
log_water_low_has_auto_hint: You're running low on water. You have bottled water in your inventory — enable auto-consume in the inventory settings.
log_water_low_none: You're running low on water! You're parched — find some before you collapse.

popup_welcome_page1:
The year is 2249. For crimes you did not commit, you were sentenced to a lifetime of hard labor in the Katarnis VII mining colony — a frozen rock circling a dying gas giant on the edge of charted space. The trial was a formality. Your poverty was your guilt.

But you refused to break. Over months of quiet observation, you learned every crack in the colony's routines. The guards grew indifferent. The supervisors lazy. One night, during a shift change, the opportunity came — a lone scout vessel, the SFC-47 Vagabond, left briefly unguarded near the maintenance bay.

With nothing but a stolen access card and a lifetime of desperation, you boarded her, fired her engines, and hurled yourself into the void before anyone could raise the alarm.
popup_welcome_page2:
Freedom was never meant to feel this fragile. The Vagabond is a light reconnaissance ship — stripped-down, fast, and never designed for deep-space travel. Her navigational data was wiped by colony security protocols. Her systems are failing one by one, and you lack the training to repair them. Every warning light is a language you were never taught to read.

You are alone. No charts. No heading. Only the cold hum of a dying ship and the silent stars beyond the viewport.

Supplies are already running thin. The onboard storage locker holds a few days' worth of rations and water — barely enough to survive. Every decision you make from here will be a matter of life and death.
popup_welcome_page3:
You are a fugitive on a stolen ship, a dying vessel, and no plan. But whatever lies ahead in this uncharted sector — it will remember your name.

Get up. Move. Survive. The stars are waiting.
